text:
deploybot: detected regression in embeddings cost after recent rollout in ap-south-1, recommended auto-revert to v2.5.0. :warning:

nina: confirming spike only on embeddings-heavy customers, latency normal.

dev-ryan: recent change toggled quantization flag + new matmul kernel. suspect kernel.

ops-mona: auto-revert scheduled in 8m. can we try targeted config revert first?

sre-lee: agree - flip QUANT_MODE back on canary, watch cost for 4m.

(4m later)

dev-ryan: canary cost down ~65%. propose progressive config roll by shard (10% steps) and set short pin for 12h to avoid churn.

pm-omar: PMs prefer pin + customer note if we touch billing. legal to be looped.

ops-mona: executing progressive roll and setting pin:
```bash
rdwctl rollout config ap-south-1 --set QUANT_MODE=legacy --steps 10
rdwctl pin service:embeddings ap-south-1 --version 2.5.0 --duration 12h --reason "cost mitigation"
```

deploybot: auto-revert suppressed during rollout window; will re-enable after 12h.

sre-lee: alerts set if embed_cost_p90 > 1.5x baseline for 15m -> escalate to eng-releases with tag rollback_exec.

nina: thanks all, closing unless new signals appear. :thumbsup:
